view.title: Analytics
view.noServices: No services yet. Deploy one and its visitors appear here on their own - no script to add.
view.fromDaily: From daily totals - one bar is a day

cards.dailyVisitorsHint: Distinct visits. Someone who came back on another day counts again - sessions are cookieless and rotate daily, so there is nothing to join them by.
cards.visitorsHint: Distinct visits in the last 24 hours.
cards.bounceHint: Visits that read exactly one page.
cards.durationHint: Average, over the visits long enough to measure.
cards.durationOff: Only measurable with the tracker on. Without it, a visit is one line in a log with no end.

breakdowns.notKept: Not kept in the daily totals this range is drawn from. Choose a shorter range to see it.
breakdowns.noScreens: A log cannot see a screen. Turn the tracker on for this one.
breakdowns.noCountries: No location yet. It is read from the visitor's time zone, so it needs the tracker.
breakdowns.noEvents: No custom events. Call polaris.event(''name'') from your page.
breakdowns.firewall: Block or inspect {ip} in the firewall

recent.title: Recent visits
recent.none: Nobody yet. A visit appears here within a minute of it happening.

tracker.title: Tracker
tracker.intro: Pageviews, referrers and devices are already being counted from the edge - this service needed no setup for that. The script adds the four things a server-side log cannot see: how long a visit lasted, the screen it was read on, single-page route changes, and your own events.
tracker.acceptHint: While this is off the endpoint ignores this key, so a script left on a page after you turn it off records nothing.
tracker.noCookies: No cookies and nothing stored on the visitor's machine, so there is nothing here to ask consent for.

settings.title: Collection
settings.edgeLog: Count visits from the edge log
settings.edgeLogHint: How every deployed service gets analytics without a script. Turning this off leaves only what the tracker sends.
settings.botsHint: Off, because a dashboard where a crawler outranks every real page is one nobody reads. The firewall is where bot traffic is worth looking at.
settings.keepHint: Addresses, individual visits and their pages are dropped after this. The daily totals behind the charts are kept, so history stays comparable without keeping a row per request.

errors.notMeasured: That is not something Polaris measures.
errors.notYoursToSee: That is not yours to look at.
errors.notYoursToChange: That is not yours to change.
errors.rules: Those ignore rules are not valid.
errors.tooMany: This site has too many saved reports.

compare.hint: Against the same span just before

filters.ignoredLong: Past 31 days only daily totals remain, so filters are not applied.

reports.name: Name
reports.pathHint: A page starts with /. End it with * to match a prefix.

sessions.title: Visits
sessions.gone: This visit is no longer kept.

events.title: Events
events.none: No custom events in this window.
events.pick: Pick an event to see its properties.

funnels.title: Funnel
funnels.intro: How many visits reached each step, in order.

journeys.title: Journeys
journeys.intro: The most common paths through the site.

goals.title: Goals
goals.intro: Share of visits that reached a page or did an event.

retention.title: Retention
retention.intro: Who came back, by the day they first came. Counts only visitors the site identifies.
retention.none: No identified visitors in this window.

revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.intro: From events with a numeric revenue property.

site.ignoreIntro: Visits to these pages or from these addresses are never recorded.
site.pathsHint: One per line. End with * to match a prefix.
site.badPath: {value} must start with / and have no spaces.
site.ipsHint: One per line. An IPv4 range like 10.0.0.0/8 works too.
site.viewOnly: You can view this site but not change it.
site.exportHint: Every page and event in this window, with its visit, as CSV.
site.resetHint: Delete every recorded visit. Settings and reports stay.
site.resetBody: Visits, events and daily totals are deleted. This cannot be undone.
site.apiIdentify: Name the visitor, so return visits are recognised.
site.apiAttr: An event on click, with no script of your own.
site.apiOutbound: On the script tag: record clicks on links to other sites.
site.apiDomains: On the script tag: only count visits on these hostnames.
site.apiDnt: On the script tag: skip browsers that ask not to be tracked.
site.apiSearch: On the script tag: drop the query string from pages.
site.apiBefore: On the script tag: a function that sees each beat and can drop it.
site.apiOptOut: Run in a browser to stop counting your own visits there.
